description:
The retheme should not be considered complete after isolated component or page
changes. The final release gate must rerun the maintained Results Explorer QA
plan plus the specific 2026-05-07 design audit checks: brand coherence,
visual hierarchy, retheme completeness, usability, accessibility,
responsiveness, and data-presentation quality.

This item closes the remediation sequence. It should produce durable evidence
that every public route renders without internal errors, looks coherent at the
requested breakpoints, and communicates benchmark rigor without visual or
semantic ambiguity.

anti_patterns.dont: bury residual defects in prose; every release-blocking issue needs a concrete TODO or fix.
ignore console or network errors because the page looks acceptable.
mark the retheme ready while any raw internal error is visible.
substitute unit tests for visual and interaction QA on this retheme.

preserves.behavior: Final evidence is stored under `_project/audits/` and can be replayed by future reviewers.
Maintained QA plan in `docs/operations/results-explorer-qa.md` remains the baseline.
No launch-ready verdict without benchmark and platform pages rendering data.

verifications.command: cd results-explorer && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build

verifications.expected: at least one final readiness report exists

work_units.notes:
Outcome: final matrix now covers 12 public states at 390px, 768px,
1280px, and 1600px: Home, TPC-H benchmark, SSB benchmark, DuckDB
platform, DataFusion platform, Polars platform, representative Result
Detail, same-cohort Compare, mismatch Compare, empty Compare, Query, and
the supported-but-empty ClickBench state. This closes the earlier gap where
Result Detail and real Compare were omitted from release evidence.
work_units.summary: Prepare the final QA run plan and route matrix

work_units.notes:
Outcome: capture spec cold-loads each route in a fresh browser context,
waits for the shell and a route-specific loaded landmark, and records
console warnings/errors, page errors, and HTTP >=400 responses. The final
`console-network-2026-05-07.log` contains only its header line across
48 route/viewport loads.
work_units.summary: Run cold-load route checks with console and network capture

work_units.notes:
Outcome: 48 fullPage screenshots are stored under
`_project/audits/screenshots/results-explorer-retheme-final-2026-05-10/`
(12 routes × 4 widths), including Result Detail and same/mismatch Compare
routes.
work_units.summary: Capture final screenshots across the viewport matrix

work_units.notes:
Outcome: existing chromium e2e coverage exercises Home mode/sort controls,
benchmark controls, benchmark/platform selection to Compare, Compare
baseline/share URL, Query filters/row limit/visible columns/export/SQL,
Result Detail methodology/sample disclosures, navigation, and breadcrumbs.
The final capture matrix adds visual evidence for the Result Detail and
real Compare states that were previously missing.
work_units.summary: Run interaction QA for filters, modes, compare, query, and disclosures

work_units.notes:
Outcome: follow-up verification ran `npm run typecheck`, full `npm test --
--run` (45 files / 506 tests), `npm run build`, Chromium Playwright smoke
on a fresh E2E port (53 passed / 6 skipped opt-in capture/performance
specs), and the opt-in final capture spec. Firefox/WebKit remain outside
this retheme gate per the existing browser-support policy.
work_units.summary: Run automated checks and browser smoke

work_units.notes:
Outcome: `_project/audits/results-explorer-retheme-final-2026-05-10.md`
now contains the expanded route matrix, 48-screenshot index,
console/network summary, accessibility/responsive summary, and residual
minor product UX items. No blocker or unowned major finding remains.
work_units.summary: Write the release-readiness report and file residual defects
